candidate_sql: SELECT r.q1_refund_amt, g.q1_gmv, ROUND(r.q1_refund_amt / g.q1_gmv * 100, 4) AS refund_rate_pct FROM (SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amt), 2) AS q1_refund_amt FROM refunds WHERE refund_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND refund_dt < '2026-04-01') r, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amt), 2) AS q1_gmv FROM orders WHERE order_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND order_dt < '2026-04-01' AND order_status <> 'cancelled') g
